pieces.Text: Once per hour, the barbarian can spit venom at an adjacent enemy as a standard action. She must make a touch attack to successfully spit on a foe in this way, but she can also apply this poison as a swift action when she hits with a bite attack. The DC of the save against this poison is
. Hissing Rage Poison (Su) Bite-contact or injury; save Fort; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect 1d2 Str damage; cure 2 consecutive saves.
